agent_explanation: Controller computes force as kp * velocity-error (+ noise) but fails to clamp to fmax. At step 0 velocity is (0, -5.84); desired velocity toward waypoint (12.1,8.8) is ~ (4.9,2.2) giving error magnitude ~9.4. kp=26.41 gives ~248 N before noise, 250.34 N after noise, exceeding fmax=194.58 at step 1. Inspect shows controller_force 250.34 at step 1. Lowering kp to 15 reduces commanded force below limit and violation disappears, confirming cause is missing fmax clamp.
